AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – TROUBLESHOOTING

Temperature Set Dial Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

When temperature set dial is turned, the voltage of TSET terminal will change. A/C amplifier searches for this change and controls the room temperature according to the temperature set.
